newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Astra boosts Swedish shares to higher close.
newsitem.headline: Astra boosts Swedish shares to higher close.

text.p: Sweden's bourse closed slightly higher on Monday and brokers said there was strength in the market with drugs major Astra posting strong gains and good interest in the property and building sectors.
The Stockholm general index rose 0.16 percent to 2,125.77 after shares worth 3.1 billion crowns changed hands.
"It seems like we are in a period of consolidation," one broker said. He said the underlying tone of the market was strong even though it had slipped from last week's highs.
The drug sector rose 0.95 percent during the day's trade after good gains on Wall Street.

Market heavyweight Astra climbed four crowns to 296.50 crowns in the wake of its performance in the U.S.. The company announced it had received its first approval for a new asthma treatment, the Oxis Turbuhaler.
Pharmacia & Upjohn fell 4.50 crowns to 239 crowns on Friday's disappointing comments about its third quarter earnings.
The building and construction sector rose 2.12 percent. Skanska jumped 9.50 to 294 crowns.
Hennes & Mauritz continued its recent upward trend, rising 21 to 940 crowns.
